notes: Coordinates and rectangles are zero based; rectangle right/bottom are exclusive.
Original crops preserve every RGBA pixel. Transparent crops replace exactly RGB 0,0,0 with RGBA 0,0,0,0.
Upstream names match exact 12x12 foreground masks, not positions in the older sheets; palette differences are allowed.
Visual labels are descriptive interpretations; all upstream aliases and properties are retained.
Original/transparent larger crops preserve native spacing; assembled variants remove only empty grid gutters from complete objects.
Assembled source-row/column maps are recorded explicitly. Layout samples are not claimed standalone objects.
Duplicate positions are retained, not discarded. Empty cells are recorded in source_cells.csv.
